choice.basis: The chart shows the mountain snowpack temperature record for the 2005-2015 review period. The 2005 endpoint is labeled 24.0°C and the 2015 endpoint is labeled 10.0°C, giving a full-period change of -14.0°C (a steady, monotonic decline across the period). This large, consistent change is not ordinary variation, so it requires substantial-change follow-up rather than routine monitoring or archive filing.
choice.option_label: Route the 2005 to 2015 mountain snowpack temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
